name: Chris
source: A veteran ParaMail rider of the First Unit. Despite her blunt personality, she is also quite shy and negative. Chris is also always hiding behind her two best friends, Hilda and Rosalie, who also happen to be her childhood friends as well. Chris is also very dependant of her friends and starts feeling lonely when she's left alone.
